name: const unsafe fn replace (& self , value : T) -> T
rule: `UnsafeCell::replace` must not be called while any other references to the wrapped value are alive.
api: impl < T > core::cell::UnsafeCell < T > { const unsafe fn replace (& self , value : T) -> T }
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for other live references to `$1.value`.
